Attended West High School in Minneapolis

Became a professional wrestler after his football career, with the American Wrestling Association
Two-time NWA World Tag Team champion with Verne Gagne and Leo Nomellini
Trained Pat O'Connor to be a professional wrestler
Worked in his father's plumbing business
Sold his father's plumbing business in the late 1960s
Became an insurance agent for Bankers Life
